newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium raises 19.95 bln Bfr from note issue.
newsitem.headline: Belgium raises 19.95 bln Bfr from note issue.

text.p: Belgium's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it raised a total of 19.95 billion Belgian francs from its issue of medium-term state notes which closed on Tuesday.
A statement said subscriptions to its five-year state notes, extendable to seven years, amounted to 13.25 billion francs.
For the 3/5/7 note - which carries a guaranteed minimum coupon and put options at three, five and seven years - subscriptions amounted to 6.70 billion francs.
The notes were to be issued on Wednesday.
It is the second time Belgium is offering medium-term notes, a new state investment product targetted at the general public. The first issue in June raised a total of 16.65 billion Belgian francs.
The ministry has said it will carry out four such issues a year, aiming to raise around 85 billion francs towards its borrowing needs.
